---- MODULE W4Od5m5p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
Voters == {"v1", "v2", "v3"}
Parties == {"pa", "pb"}
NONE == "none"
Majority == 2

VARIABLES owner, ballots, phase, prop, rounds

vars == <<owner, ballots, phase, prop, rounds>>

MaxRounds == 3
Ballot == {"yes", "no", NONE}
Phases == {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}

YesCount == Cardinality({v \in Voters : ballots[v] = "yes"})
NoCount  == Cardinality({v \in Voters : ballots[v] = "no"})

Init ==
    /\ owner   = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ ballots = [v \in Voters |-> NONE]
    /\ phase   = "idle"
    /\ prop    = [slot |-> NONE, party |-> NONE]
    /\ rounds  = 0

Open(s, p) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ rounds < MaxRounds
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ prop'    = [slot |-> s, party |-> p]
    /\ ballots' = [v \in Voters |-> NONE]
    /\ phase'   = "voting"
    /\ rounds'  = rounds + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Cast(v, b) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ ballots[v] = NONE
    /\ ballots'   = [ballots EXCEPT ![v] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, phase, prop, rounds>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ YesCount >= Majority
    /\ owner'  = [owner EXCEPT ![prop.slot] = prop.party]
    /\ phase'  = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballots, prop, rounds>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ NoCount >= Majority
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ballots, prop, rounds>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase'   = "idle"
    /\ prop'    = [slot |-> NONE, party |-> NONE]
    /\ ballots' = [v \in Voters |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, rounds>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ (rounds = MaxRounds \/ \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # NONE)
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots, p \in Parties : Open(s, p)
    \/ Quiesce
    \/ \E v \in Voters, b \in {"yes", "no"} : Cast(v, b)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner   \in [Slots -> Parties \cup {NONE}]
    /\ ballots \in [Voters -> Ballot]
    /\ phase   \in Phases
    /\ rounds  \in 0..MaxRounds

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    (phase = "voting") => (owner[prop.slot] = NONE)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker assigns each match slot to exactly one player
party. Because slots are scarce, allocation of a slot requires a quorum vote: a
coordinator opens a proposal binding one free slot to one party, each voter casts
a yes/no ballot, and the coordinator commits the binding only once a strict
majority of voters have said yes. A voter may be slow to respond but never fails,
so every voter eventually has a recorded ballot. If a majority instead votes no,
the round aborts. After a commit or abort the coordinator resets back to idle so a
new proposal can begin. A slot that already has an owner is never put up for a
new proposal.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A quorum proposal is never opened on a slot that is already owned, so no slot is ever allocated to two different parties.

---- MODULE W4Od14m1p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets, TLC

Drones == {"d1", "d2", "d3"}
Sectors == {"x", "y"}
NONE == "none"
MaxOv == 2

Nxt == ("d1" :> "d2") @@ ("d2" :> "d3") @@ ("d3" :> "d1")

VARIABLES holder, grants, pending, overrides

vars == <<holder, grants, pending, overrides>>

GrantRec == [sector : Sectors, drone : Drones]
Granted(s) == \E g \in grants : g.sector = s

Init ==
    /\ holder    = "d1"
    /\ grants    = {}
    /\ pending   = NONE
    /\ overrides = 0

Pass ==
    /\ holder'    = Nxt[holder]
    /\ pending'   = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, overrides>>

Request(s) ==
    /\ pending = NONE
    /\ ~ Granted(s)
    /\ pending' = s
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, grants, overrides>>

Grant ==
    /\ pending # NONE
    /\ ~ Granted(pending)
    /\ grants'  = grants \cup {[sector |-> pending, drone |-> holder]}
    /\ pending' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, overrides>>

Release(g) ==
    /\ g \in grants
    /\ g.drone = holder
    /\ grants'  = grants \ {g}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, pending, overrides>>

AdminOverride(d) ==
    /\ overrides < MaxOv
    /\ holder'    = d
    /\ overrides' = overrides + 1
    /\ pending'   = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED grants

Next ==
    \/ Pass
    \/ \E s \in Sectors : Request(s)
    \/ Grant
    \/ \E g \in grants : Release(g)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : AdminOverride(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder    \in Drones
    /\ grants    \subseteq GrantRec
    /\ pending   \in Sectors \cup {NONE}
    /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOv

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A g1, g2 \in grants : (g1.sector = g2.sector) => (g1.drone = g2.drone)

====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares a set of airspace sectors. To avoid two
drones flying the same sector, exclusive access is governed by a single token that
circulates around a fixed ring of drones: only the drone currently holding the
token may reserve a sector, and only if that sector is not already reserved. The
holder can pass the token to the next drone in the ring, request a free sector,
have that reservation granted, or release a sector it holds. A privileged ground
admin can override the ring at any time by forcibly handing the token to any drone
of its choosing (clearing that drone's pending request), which is why the ring
order alone cannot be trusted to guarantee exclusivity. Reservations are tracked
as sector-to-drone grants.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No sector is ever granted to two different drones at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od8m6p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Students == {"a", "b"}
NONE == "none"
Dur == 2
MaxT == 6

VARIABLES now, holder, expiry, editing

vars == <<now, holder, expiry, editing>>

Valid == (holder # NONE) /\ (now < expiry)

Init ==
    /\ now     = 0
    /\ holder  = NONE
    /\ expiry  = 0
    /\ editing = {}

Acquire(s) ==
    /\ editing = {}
    /\ (holder = NONE \/ now >= expiry)
    /\ holder'  = s
    /\ expiry'  = now + Dur
    /\ UNCHANGED <<now, editing>>

Renew(s) ==
    /\ holder = s
    /\ now < expiry
    /\ expiry' = now + Dur
    /\ UNCHANGED <<now, holder, editing>>

Enter(s) ==
    /\ holder = s
    /\ now < expiry
    /\ editing = {}
    /\ editing' = {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<now, holder, expiry>>

Exit(s) ==
    /\ s \in editing
    /\ editing' = editing \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<now, holder, expiry>>

Tick ==
    /\ now < MaxT
    /\ now' = now + 1
    /\ editing' = IF now + 1 >= expiry THEN {} ELSE editing
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Students : Acquire(s)
    \/ \E s \in Students : Renew(s)
    \/ \E s \in Students : Enter(s)
    \/ \E s \in Students : Exit(s)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ now     \in 0..MaxT
    /\ holder  \in Students \cup {NONE}
    /\ expiry  \in 0..(MaxT + Dur)
    /\ editing \subseteq Students

LeaseME ==
    \A s \in editing : (holder = s) /\ (now < expiry)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LeaseME
nl:
A university course-registration system protects the edit section of each course
record with a lease-based lock. A student acquires a lease on the critical edit
section that is stamped with an expiry time; only the current lease holder may
enter the section, and only while the lease is still valid. Students can be slow
but never crash, so the system relies on lease expiry rather than failure
detection: when the clock advances past the expiry, any occupant is automatically
evicted from the section so a new lease can be granted. A holder may renew its
lease before it expires, and must exit the section when done. A fresh lease is
only granted when the section is empty and the previous lease has lapsed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any student inside the edit section is the current lease holder and its lease has not yet expired, so at most one student edits at a time.

---- MODULE W4Od15m5p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Insts == {"i1", "i2"}
Voters == {"v1", "v2", "v3"}
Q == 2

VARIABLES votes, done, pool, opened

vars == <<votes, done, pool, opened>>

Init ==
    /\ votes  = [i \in Insts |-> {}]
    /\ done   = [i \in Insts |-> FALSE]
    /\ pool   = 1
    /\ opened = [i \in Insts |-> FALSE]

OpenAuction(i) ==
    /\ ~opened[i]
    /\ opened' = [opened EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, done, pool>>

CastVote(i, v) ==
    /\ opened[i]
    /\ ~done[i]
    /\ v \notin votes[i]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = votes[i] \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<done, pool, opened>>

Withdraw(i, v) ==
    /\ ~done[i]
    /\ v \in votes[i]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = votes[i] \ {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<done, pool, opened>>

Fire(i) ==
    /\ opened[i]
    /\ ~done[i]
    /\ Cardinality(votes[i]) >= Q
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE]
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, opened>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ (pool = 0 \/ \A i \in Insts : done[i])
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Insts : OpenAuction(i)
    \/ \E i \in Insts, v \in Voters : CastVote(i, v)
    \/ \E i \in Insts, v \in Voters : Withdraw(i, v)
    \/ \E i \in Insts : Fire(i)
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ votes  \in [Insts -> SUBSET Voters]
    /\ done   \in [Insts -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ pool   \in 0..1
    /\ opened \in [Insts -> BOOLEAN]

DoneImpliesQuorum ==
    \A i \in Insts : done[i] => (Cardinality(votes[i]) >= Q)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DoneImpliesQuorum
nl:
A stock exchange runs two independent opening-auction instances that draw their
single settlement print from one shared execution pool. Firing an instance's
opening print is irreversible, so it must be authorized: each instance opens,
collects yes-ballots from a panel of voters, and may only fire once a quorum of
the panel has voted for it and the shared pool still has capacity. Because the two
instances share one pool, at most one of them can ever actually print. Before an
instance fires, a voter may withdraw its ballot; after it fires nothing about that
instance changes. When the pool is exhausted or both instances have printed, the
system quiesces.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No instance ever fires its irreversible print without having reached the required quorum of ballots.

---- MODULE W4Od18m2p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Locks == {"l1", "l2"}
NONE == "none"
Vote == {"yes", "no", NONE}
Phases == {"idle", "preparing", "committed", "aborted"}

VARIABLES phase, votes, fired, adminForced

vars == <<phase, votes, fired, adminForced>>

Init ==
    /\ phase       = "idle"
    /\ votes       = [l \in Locks |-> NONE]
    /\ fired       = FALSE
    /\ adminForced = FALSE

Start ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ ~fired
    /\ phase' = "preparing"
    /\ votes' = [l \in Locks |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fired, adminForced>>

CastVote(l, v) ==
    /\ phase = "preparing"
    /\ votes[l] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![l] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, fired, adminForced>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "preparing"
    /\ ~fired
    /\ \A l \in Locks : votes[l] = "yes"
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ fired' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, adminForced>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "preparing"
    /\ \E l \in Locks : votes[l] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, fired, adminForced>>

AdminForce ==
    /\ ~fired
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "preparing", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ fired' = TRUE
    /\ adminForced' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

Reset ==
    /\ phase = "aborted"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ votes' = [l \in Locks |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fired, adminForced>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ phase = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Start
    \/ \E l \in Locks, v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(l, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ AdminForce
    \/ Reset
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase       \in Phases
    /\ votes       \in [Locks -> Vote]
    /\ fired       \in BOOLEAN
    /\ adminForced \in BOOLEAN

CommitJustified ==
    (phase = "committed") =>
        ((\A l \in Locks : votes[l] = "yes") \/ adminForced)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CommitJustified
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network unlocks the front door through a two-phase commit
across all its lock devices. A coordinator starts a round and each lock votes yes
or no on whether it is safe to unlock. The physical unlock is irreversible and
must happen at most once per round: the coordinator commits (firing the unlock)
only when every lock has voted yes, after which the round is done and cannot fire
again. If any lock votes no the round aborts and may be reset to try again. A
privileged home admin can override the vote entirely and force a commit at any
time. Once the unlock has fired it is never re-fired.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The door only ever commits an unlock when every lock voted yes or a privileged admin forced it.

---- MODULE W4Od17m9p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Ctrls == {"r1", "r2"}
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES epoch, using, grantedEpoch, inbox

vars == <<epoch, using, grantedEpoch, inbox>>

Msg == [router : Ctrls, epoch : 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
    /\ epoch        = 0
    /\ using        = {}
    /\ grantedEpoch = [r \in Ctrls |-> 0]
    /\ inbox        = {}

RequestAccess(r) ==
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[router |-> r, epoch |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, using, grantedEpoch>>

Grant(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ m.epoch = epoch
    /\ using = {}
    /\ using'        = {m.router}
    /\ grantedEpoch' = [grantedEpoch EXCEPT ![m.router] = epoch]
    /\ inbox'        = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Release(r) ==
    /\ r \in using
    /\ using' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, grantedEpoch, inbox>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ using' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantedEpoch, inbox>>

DropStale(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ m.epoch # epoch
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, using, grantedEpoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Ctrls : RequestAccess(r)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Grant(m)
    \/ \E r \in Ctrls : Release(r)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E m \in inbox : DropStale(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch        \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ using        \subseteq Ctrls
    /\ grantedEpoch \in [Ctrls -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ inbox        \subseteq Msg

EpochME ==
    \A r \in using : grantedEpoch[r] = epoch

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT EpochME
nl:
An airport baggage router guards a shared belt segment (the critical resource) that
only one routing controller may drive at a time. The system reconfigures itself
with epoch numbers: whenever the layout changes the epoch is bumped, any current
occupant of the belt is evicted, and access requests stamped with an old epoch
become stale. Controllers request access by posting a message stamped with the
epoch they saw; because the message fabric reorders freely, requests accumulate in
a pool and are delivered in any order. A request is granted only if its epoch
still matches the current epoch and the belt is free, recording the epoch under
which access was granted. Occupants release when done, and stale messages are
dropped.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every controller currently occupying the belt was granted under the epoch that is still current, ensuring only one controller drives the belt.

---- MODULE W4Od8m5p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Advisors == {"w1", "w2"}
Voters == {"v1", "v2", "v3"}
Q == 2
MaxVer == 3
NA == "none"

VARIABLES version, active, votes, applied

vars == <<version, active, votes, applied>>

NoActive == [writer |-> NA, base |-> 0]

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ active  = NoActive
    /\ votes   = {}
    /\ applied = {}

Propose(w) ==
    /\ active.writer = NA
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ active' = [writer |-> w, base |-> version]
    /\ votes'  = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied>>

Vote(v) ==
    /\ active.writer # NA
    /\ v \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, active, applied>>

Commit ==
    /\ active.writer # NA
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Q
    /\ active.base = version
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {active}
    /\ active'  = NoActive
    /\ votes'   = {}

Reject ==
    /\ active.writer # NA
    /\ active.base # version
    /\ active' = NoActive
    /\ votes'  = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ active.writer = NA
    /\ version = MaxVer
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Advisors : Propose(w)
    \/ \E v \in Voters : Vote(v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Reject
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ active  \in [writer : Advisors \cup {NA}, base : 0..MaxVer]
    /\ votes   \subseteq Voters
    /\ applied \subseteq [writer : Advisors, base : 0..MaxVer]

NoLostUpdate ==
    \A a, b \in applied : (a # b) => (a.base # b.base)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A university course-registration system keeps a shared course record with a version
number. To prevent lost updates when several advisors edit concurrently, every
change is a read-modify-write authorized by a quorum: an advisor proposes an
update stamped with the version it read, a panel of voters casts ballots (which
arrive in any order and simply accumulate), and the update is applied only once a
quorum has voted AND the stamped base version still equals the record's current
version. Applying an update bumps the version. A proposal whose base version has
gone stale is rejected without being applied. When the record reaches its final
version and no proposal is active, the system quiesces.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two applied updates were ever committed against the same base version, so no update silently overwrites another.

---- MODULE W4Od19m5p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Books == {"b1", "b2"}
Librarians == {"v1", "v2", "v3"}
Patrons == {"p1", "p2"}
Q == 2
NA == "none"

VARIABLES request, votes, issued, forced

vars == <<request, votes, issued, forced>>

Init ==
    /\ request = [b \in Books |-> NA]
    /\ votes   = [b \in Books |-> {}]
    /\ issued  = [b \in Books |-> FALSE]
    /\ forced  = [b \in Books |-> FALSE]

Reserve(b, p) ==
    /\ request[b] = NA
    /\ ~issued[b]
    /\ request' = [request EXCEPT ![b] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, issued, forced>>

Vote(b, l) ==
    /\ request[b] # NA
    /\ ~issued[b]
    /\ l \notin votes[b]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = votes[b] \cup {l}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<request, issued, forced>>

Issue(b) ==
    /\ request[b] # NA
    /\ ~issued[b]
    /\ Cardinality(votes[b]) >= Q
    /\ issued' = [issued EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<request, votes, forced>>

AdminForce(b, p) ==
    /\ ~issued[b]
    /\ request' = [request EXCEPT ![b] = p]
    /\ issued'  = [issued EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ forced'  = [forced EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

Cancel(b) ==
    /\ request[b] # NA
    /\ ~issued[b]
    /\ Cardinality(votes[b]) < Q
    /\ request' = [request EXCEPT ![b] = NA]
    /\ votes'   = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, forced>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ \A b \in Books : issued[b]
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Books, p \in Patrons : Reserve(b, p)
    \/ \E b \in Books, l \in Librarians : Vote(b, l)
    \/ \E b \in Books : Issue(b)
    \/ \E b \in Books, p \in Patrons : AdminForce(b, p)
    \/ \E b \in Books : Cancel(b)
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ request \in [Books -> Patrons \cup {NA}]
    /\ votes   \in [Books -> SUBSET Librarians]
    /\ issued  \in [Books -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ forced  \in [Books -> BOOLEAN]

IssueAuthorized ==
    \A b \in Books :
        issued[b] =>
            /\ request[b] # NA
            /\ (Cardinality(votes[b]) >= Q \/ forced[b])

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT IssueAuthorized
nl:
A library book-reservation system finalizes a hold on each book at most once: once
a book is issued to a patron that decision is irreversible. Issuing normally
requires authorization by a quorum of on-duty librarians: a patron reserves a book,
librarians cast ballots for that reservation, and the hold is issued only when a
quorum has voted and no hold exists yet. A privileged admin can override the quorum
and force-issue a book to a chosen patron at any time before it is issued. A
pending reservation with too few votes may be cancelled and retried. Once every
book has been issued the system quiesces.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A book is issued only if it has a recorded patron and either a quorum of librarians voted for it or an admin forced it.

---- MODULE W4Od18m1p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, TLC

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Total == 3

Nxt == ("n1" :> "n2") @@ ("n2" :> "n3") @@ ("n3" :> "n1")

VARIABLES holder, credits, active

vars == <<holder, credits, active>>

Sum == credits["n1"] + credits["n2"] + credits["n3"]

Init ==
    /\ holder  = "n1"
    /\ credits = ("n1" :> 2) @@ ("n2" :> 1) @@ ("n3" :> 0)
    /\ active  = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]

Pass ==
    /\ holder' = Nxt[holder]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<credits, active>>

Move ==
    /\ credits[holder] > 0
    /\ LET dst == Nxt[holder] IN
         credits' = [credits EXCEPT ![holder] = @ - 1, ![dst] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, active>>

Deactivate(n) ==
    /\ active[n]
    /\ n # holder
    /\ credits' = [credits EXCEPT ![holder] = @ + credits[n], ![n] = 0]
    /\ active'  = [active EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED holder

Activate(n) ==
    /\ ~active[n]
    /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, credits>>

Next ==
    \/ Pass
    \/ Move
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Deactivate(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Activate(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder  \in Nodes
    /\ credits \in [Nodes -> 0..Total]
    /\ active  \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]

Conserved == Sum = Total

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network passes a fixed pool of power credits around a ring
of lock nodes using a circulating token. Only the token holder may act. The holder
can pass the token to the next node in the ring, or hand one power credit to the
next node. The ring's capacity changes at runtime: a node can be deactivated (in
which case all of its credits are handed to the token holder so none are lost) or
reactivated. No matter how credits move or how the ring is reconfigured, credits
are never created or destroyed, only relocated among nodes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of power credits summed over all nodes always equals the fixed initial pool.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m1p2t4 ----

    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ owner[sl] = NONE
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, sl)
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {sl}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, dropped>>

    /\ inbox'   = inbox \ {sl}

    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, owner>>

    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![Head(queue)] = d]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)

work queue with backpressure, ensuring no sector slot is ever allocated to two
drones. Patrol requests for free sectors arrive on a reordering bus, so they are
absorbed in any order. A request taken from the bus is enqueued only if the queue

---- MODULE W4Od5m7p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Players == {"p1", "p2", "p3"}
FREE == "free"
STARTED == "started"
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES reg, started, starter, crashed

vars == <<reg, started, starter, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ reg     = FREE
    /\ started = FALSE
    /\ starter = NONE
    /\ crashed = {}

CASClaim(p) ==
    /\ reg = FREE
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ reg' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED <<started, starter, crashed>>

StartMatch ==
    /\ reg \in Players
    /\ ~started
    /\ started' = TRUE
    /\ starter' = reg
    /\ reg'     = STARTED
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
    /\ reg'     = IF reg = p THEN FREE ELSE reg
    /\ UNCHANGED <<started, starter>>

Release(p) ==
    /\ reg = p
    /\ reg' = FREE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<started, starter, crashed>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ (started \/ crashed = Players)
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : CASClaim(p)
    \/ StartMatch
    \/ \E p \in Players : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Release(p)
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg     \in Players \cup {FREE, STARTED}
    /\ started \in BOOLEAN
    /\ starter \in Players \cup {NONE}
    /\ crashed \subseteq Players

StartConsumed == started <=> (reg = STARTED)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT StartConsumed
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker uses a single compare-and-swap register to
decide who gets to fire the irreversible match-start, which must happen at most
once. The register holds FREE, a claiming player, or the terminal value STARTED. A
player claims the start-token by swapping the register from FREE to itself; the
holder then starts the match, which swaps the register to STARTED and records the
starter. Once the register reads STARTED it can never be reclaimed or re-started,
so the match starts exactly once at most. A player may crash silently at any time;
if a crashed player was merely holding the register (not the terminal STARTED
value) the register is released back to FREE so another player can claim it. A
holder may also release voluntarily.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The match is recorded as started if and only if the register holds the terminal STARTED value, so the irreversible start fires at most once.

---- MODULE W4Od19m8p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, TLC

Patrons == {"p1", "p2"}
Shelves == {"sh1", "sh2"}
Copies == {"c1", "c2"}
NA == "none"

ShelfOf == ("c1" :> "sh1") @@ ("c2" :> "sh2")

VARIABLES shelfLock, copyLock, coarseReq, fineReq

vars == <<shelfLock, copyLock, coarseReq, fineReq>>

CReq == [patron : Patrons, shelf : Shelves]
FReq == [patron : Patrons, copy : Copies]

Init ==
    /\ shelfLock = [s \in Shelves |-> NA]
    /\ copyLock  = [c \in Copies |-> NA]
    /\ coarseReq = {}
    /\ fineReq   = {}

ReqCoarse(p, s) ==
    /\ coarseReq' = coarseReq \cup {[patron |-> p, shelf |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelfLock, copyLock, fineReq>>

GrantCoarse(m) ==
    /\ m \in coarseReq
    /\ shelfLock[m.shelf] = NA
    /\ shelfLock' = [shelfLock EXCEPT ![m.shelf] = m.patron]
    /\ coarseReq' = coarseReq \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<copyLock, fineReq>>

ReqFine(p, c) ==
    /\ fineReq' = fineReq \cup {[patron |-> p, copy |-> c]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelfLock, copyLock, coarseReq>>

GrantFine(m) ==
    /\ m \in fineReq
    /\ shelfLock[ShelfOf[m.copy]] = m.patron
    /\ copyLock[m.copy] = NA
    /\ copyLock' = [copyLock EXCEPT ![m.copy] = m.patron]
    /\ fineReq'  = fineReq \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelfLock, coarseReq>>

DropFine(m) ==
    /\ m \in fineReq
    /\ shelfLock[ShelfOf[m.copy]] # m.patron
    /\ fineReq' = fineReq \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelfLock, copyLock, coarseReq>>

ReleaseFine(p, c) ==
    /\ copyLock[c] = p
    /\ copyLock' = [copyLock EXCEPT ![c] = NA]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelfLock, coarseReq, fineReq>>

ReleaseCoarse(p, s) ==
    /\ shelfLock[s] = p
    /\ \A c \in Copies : (ShelfOf[c] = s) => copyLock[c] # p
    /\ shelfLock' = [shelfLock EXCEPT ![s] = NA]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<copyLock, coarseReq, fineReq>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, s \in Shelves : ReqCoarse(p, s)
    \/ \E m \in coarseReq : GrantCoarse(m)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, c \in Copies : ReqFine(p, c)
    \/ \E m \in fineReq : GrantFine(m)
    \/ \E m \in fineReq : DropFine(m)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, c \in Copies : ReleaseFine(p, c)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, s \in Shelves : ReleaseCoarse(p, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ shelfLock \in [Shelves -> Patrons \cup {NA}]
    /\ copyLock  \in [Copies -> Patrons \cup {NA}]
    /\ coarseReq \subseteq CReq
    /\ fineReq   \subseteq FReq

HierHold ==
    \A c \in Copies :
        (copyLock[c] # NA) => (shelfLock[ShelfOf[c]] = copyLock[c])

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT HierHold
nl:
A library book-reservation system uses hierarchical locking so that no copy slot is
ever allocated to two patrons. To reserve a specific copy a patron must first hold
the coarse lock on the copy's shelf, then obtain the fine lock on the copy itself.
Both coarse and fine lock requests travel over a reordering message bus and are
serviced in any order. A coarse request is granted when the shelf is free. A fine
request is granted only if the requesting patron already holds the enclosing shelf
lock and the copy is free; a fine request from a patron who does not hold the shelf
lock is simply dropped. Patrons release the fine lock when done with a copy and the
shelf lock once they hold no copies on it. Every fine lock is therefore backed by
the same patron's shelf lock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any patron holding a copy's fine lock also holds the coarse lock on that copy's shelf, so no copy is ever allocated to two patrons.

    /\ dropped' = IF dropped < MaxDrop THEN dropped + 1 ELSE dropped

    /\ owner[Head(queue)] = NONE
    /\ r \notin crashed

    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)

NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleAlloc
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet assigns storage bays to robots through a bounded work queue
with backpressure, and no bay is ever allocated to two robots. Bay-assignment tasks
are submitted into the queue only while it is below capacity; once the queue is full
further submissions are rejected as backpressure, which is counted. A robot takes
the bay at the front of the queue and is allocated it, provided the bay is
currently unowned and the robot has not crashed. Any robot can crash silently at
any time; when it does, every bay it held is immediately released so those bays do
not stay locked to a vanished robot. A robot may also release a bay when it
finishes. Consequently no bay is ever owned by a crashed robot or simultaneously
waiting in the queue.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every allocated bay is owned by a robot that has not crashed and is not also waiting in the work queue.

---- MODULE W4Od7m4p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

Insts == {"i1", "i2"}
Cap == 2
MaxVer == 3
MaxDrop == 3

vars == <<version, queue, applied, dropped>>

Upd == [inst : Insts, base : 0..MaxVer]

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ queue   = <<>>
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ dropped = 0

Submit(i) ==
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, [inst |-> i, base |-> version])
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied, dropped>>

Overflow(i) ==
    /\ Len(queue) >= Cap
    /\ dropped' = IF dropped < MaxDrop THEN dropped + 1 ELSE dropped
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, queue, applied>>

Apply ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ Head(queue).base = version
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {Head(queue)}
    /\ queue'   = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED dropped

Discard ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ Head(queue).base # version
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied, dropped>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ version = MaxVer
    /\ Len(queue) = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

    \/ \E i \in Insts : Submit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Insts : Overflow(i)
    \/ Apply
    \/ Discard
    \/ Quiesce

    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ queue   \in Seq(Upd)
    /\ applied \subseteq Upd
    /\ dropped \in 0..MaxDrop

NoLostUpdate ==
    \A a, b \in applied : (a # b) => (a.base # b.base)

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A container-ship crane yard has two independent crane-control instances that update
one shared cargo manifest, which carries a version number. To avoid lost updates,
edits flow through one shared bounded work queue with backpressure: an instance
submits an update stamped with the manifest version it read, appended to the queue
only while the queue is below capacity; when the queue is full the submission is
rejected as backpressure and counted. The applier takes the update at the front of
the queue and applies it only if its stamped base version still equals the
manifest's current version, which bumps the version; an update whose base version
has gone stale is discarded without being applied. Because both instances feed the
one shared queue, concurrent edits cannot silently clobber each other.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two applied updates were committed against the same base manifest version, so no update silently overwrites another.

NEXT Next
INVARIANT TokenME
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker grants exclusive access to a single shared match
server (the critical resource) using a token that circulates around a ring of
lobbies. Only the lobby currently holding the token may enter the match server, and
only one lobby is ever inside at a time. The holder can pass the token to the next
lobby in the ring, but only while no lobby is inside the server. A lobby enters the
server when it holds the token and the server is empty, and leaves when done. A
privileged admin can override the ring from a limited budget by forcibly handing
the token to any lobby, which evicts whoever is currently inside so that the new
token holder is the only one who may enter.

    /\ credits = ("n1" :> 2) @@ ("n2" :> 1) @@ ("n3" :> 0)
    /\ active  = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ carried = 0

Pass ==
    /\ carried = 0
    /\ holder' = Nxt[holder]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<credits, active, carried>>

Pickup ==
    /\ carried = 0
    /\ credits[holder] > 0
    /\ credits' = [credits EXCEPT ![holder] = @ - 1]
    /\ carried' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, active>>

Deposit ==
    /\ carried = 1
    /\ LET dst == Nxt[holder] IN
         credits' = [credits EXCEPT ![dst] = @ + 1]
    /\ carried' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, active>>

Deactivate(n) ==
    /\ active[n]
    /\ n # holder
    /\ credits' = [credits EXCEPT ![holder] = @ + credits[n], ![n] = 0]
    /\ active'  = [active EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, carried>>

Activate(n) ==
    /\ ~active[n]
    /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, credits, carried>>

Next ==
    \/ Pass
    \/ Pickup
    \/ Deposit
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Deactivate(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Activate(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

    /\ holder  \in Nodes
    /\ credits \in [Nodes -> 0..Total]
    /\ active  \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ carried \in 0..1

nl:
A smart-home door-lock network passes a fixed pool of power credits around a ring
of lock nodes using a circulating token. Only the token holder may act. The holder
can pass the token to the next node in the ring, pick one power credit up off its
own node into the token (briefly in transit), or deposit the credit it is carrying
onto the next node. The ring's capacity changes at runtime: a node can be
deactivated (in which case all of its credits are handed to the token holder so
none are lost) or reactivated. No matter how credits move or how the ring is
reconfigured, credits are never created or destroyed -- they are only relocated
among nodes or held in transit on the token.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of power credits, summed over all nodes plus any credit in transit, always equals the fixed initial pool.
